build._doc: Bake this page's commit history into src/data-generated/commits.json so the Commits panel renders from the bundle instead of calling api.github.com from the visitor's browser, where the unauthenticated 60/hour-per-IP limit meant it almost always showed 'rate limit reached'. MUST run before esbuild, which inlines the JSON. Kept OUT of src/data/ on purpose: that directory is for hand-authored content, every *.json in it gets a PORTAL_DATA wrapper shipped to dist (dead weight here, the JSON is imported directly) and gets consolidated by 1_front-configs. Never fails the build: on a fetch error the previous file is kept.
Wrap every *.json in src/data/ as a globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[<key>] companion (data-*.json.js). Engine: front-data-json-js-wrapper.sh.
Generate the full PWA app-icon set from one source image. Idempotent — skips when outputs are newer than source. Re-runs only when public/favicon.jpg changes.

Generate vCard files + styled QR PNGs + qrcode.html from src/typescript/qrcode/qrcodes.json. Engine: front-qrcode-gen.sh (compiles with LOCAL tsc then runs with node — deps declared in package.json: typescript, qr-code-styling, qrcode, sharp, jsdom). MUST run BEFORE the copy steps that ship qrcode.html + qrcodes.json + the PNGs to dist/.
QR code gallery page (data-driven — fetches qrcodes.json at runtime).

GitHub Pages list page (linktree.diegonmarcos.com/gh). Reads data-gh-pages.json.js (copied below from src/data) generated by scripts/gh-pages-gen.mjs; no runtime API calls. GitHub Pages serves gh.html at /gh, same as qrcode.html at /qrcode.
Manifest consumed at runtime by qrcode.html (the cards) — same JSON the qr-code generator reads (the QRs + vCard files). Copied flat to dist root; the HTML fetches it as './qrcodes.json'.

Deploy the data-*.json.js wrappers from the linktree-owned data hub to dist root, so any consumer can <script src="data-NAME.json.js"> with no fetch / no CORS. Source-of-truth lives in linktree/src/data/ (linktree owns the link data; sibling projects symlink in).
Inject navigator.serviceWorker.register(...) before </head>. MUST run BEFORE esbuild_sw so the modified HTML feeds into BUILD_HASH.

Inject single-namespace observability SDK (Sentry/OpenObserve-style). Mirrors console.* + errors + SW lifecycle to OPFS console.log. window.consoleLogs.{captureException, captureMessage, addBreadcrumb, read, readJSON, tail, clear, download}.
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
